attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This is a mass-regeneration of dozens of shared client-side scripts (including core third-party libraries like jQuery, CodeMirror, jsplumb, and vue-multiselect) using a new build pipeline that now enables identifier mangling and repurposes the non-min .js files as mangled/minified output with sourcemap references, so a subtle bug in the new min.mjs logic or mangle setting could silently break widely-used admin UI functionality across nearly every module and downstream application."}
